name: room
label: Room
help: The waiting room name: 1 to 64 letters, digits, - or _, such as presale.

name: admitPerMinute
label: Admit per minute
help: How many visitors to let through each minute. Required when the room is new; leave empty to keep the current rate.

name: state
label: State

options.label: Paused (visitors can join, nobody is admitted)

help: Leave empty to keep the current state. A new room opens.

name: startsAt
label: Starts at
help: When admission starts. Visitors can join the queue before then.

name: title
label: Title
help: Shown on the waiting page, at most 120 characters.

name: burst
label: Burst
help: How many visitors may be admitted at once when the queue starts moving.

name: passTtlSeconds
label: Pass lifetime (seconds)
help: How long an admitted visitor stays in: 60 to 86400. Default 1800.

name: returnUrls
label: Return URLs
help: Addresses visitors may be sent back to (https; http only for localhost). Up to 10.
